chapters.name: Xue Er (On Learning & Integrity)
chapters.subtitle: The joy of learning and noble character

verses.text: The Master said: 'Is it not pleasant to learn with a constant perseverance and application? Is it not delightful to have friends coming from distant quarters? Is he not a noble person who feels no discomposure though men take no note of him?'
verses.original: 子曰：「學而時習之，不亦說乎？有朋自遠方來，不亦樂乎？人不知而不慍，不亦君子乎？」
verses.transliteration: Zǐ yuē: Xué ér shí xí zhī, bù yì yuè hū?...

verses.text: Master Zeng said: 'I daily examine myself on three points: whether, in transacting business for others, I have failed to be faithful; whether, in intercourse with friends, I have failed to be sincere; whether I have failed to practice what I have been taught.'
verses.original: 曾子曰：「吾日三省吾身：為人謀而不忠乎？與朋友交而不信乎？傳不習乎？」
verses.transliteration: Zēngzǐ yuē: Wú rì sān xǐng wú shēn...

chapters.name: Wei Zheng (On Governance & Virtue)
chapters.subtitle: Leading through moral excellence rather than force

verses.text: The Master said: 'He who exercises government by means of his virtue may be compared to the north polar star, which keeps its place and all the stars turn towards it.'
verses.original: 子曰：「為政以德，譬如北辰，居其所而眾星共之。」
verses.transliteration: Zǐ yuē: Wéi zhèng yǐ dé, pì rú běi chén...

verses.text: The Master said: 'Learning without thought is labor lost; thought without learning is perilous.'
verses.original: 子曰：「學而不思則罔，思而不學則殆。」
verses.transliteration: Zǐ yuē: Xué ér bù sī zé wǎng, sī ér bù xué zé dài.

verses.text: Zigong asked: 'Is there one single word that can guide one's entire life?' The Master said: 'Is not Reciprocity (Shu) such a word? What you do not want done to yourself, do not do to others.'
verses.original: 子貢問曰：「有一言而可以終身行之者乎？」子曰：「其恕乎！己所不欲，勿施於人。」
verses.transliteration: Zǐgòng wèn yuē... Zǐ yuē: Qí shù hū! Jǐ suǒ bù yù, wù shī yú rén.
